name: A611RING Einstein ring (Hubble)
blurb: A611RING, an Einstein ring of a distant star-forming galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: a611ring-hubble
story: The gravity of an elliptical galaxy bends the light of a far more distant galaxy into a ring, and Hubble came to dissect the intensely star-forming clumps inside it.

claims.text: A611RING is the target of Hubble program 13411, an Einstein ring
The ring is the gravitationally lensed image of a star-forming galaxy
The lens is an elliptical galaxy
The program studies the intensely star-forming clumps in the lensed galaxy
